tokenizer_mode_and_parsers: deepseek_v4 (V4.1 used deepseek_v41); chat_template_kwargs.thinking=false maps to chat mode in both
server: identical to V4.1: TP8 + EP, gpu_memory_utilization 0.90, max_model_len 262144, max_num_seqs 64, default max_num_batched_tokens, default KV dtype, --language-model-only, speculation off

launches.note: V4.1 ran concurrency/context/prefix-off on 'off' and isolated on 'off-profidle'; V4.1 control showed idle profiler has no measurable effect (c1 88.4 vs 88.7, c64 292.3 vs 292.2 tok/s). Using one launch for 0731 avoids an extra restart.

workloads_prompts_seeds_repeats: identical to plan.json / V4.1 harness. Random prompts are generated per model tokenizer to the same token count; prefix JSONL prompt files are the same text files used for V4.1 (token counts recorded if tokenizers differ).
model_order: V4.1 measured first (earlier session same day, same node); 0731 second. Cross-model order alternation not done (would need extra restarts) -> recorded deviation.
validity: same rules; if 0731 tokenization of the shared prefix files is shorter than 98% of expected, the prompt-token check is relaxed to the measured per-model count and recorded
